name: Blankenburg (Harz, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Blankenburg (Harz) (a white tower between a stag's antler and a figure on black).
history: The hoisted flag is divided black and red and charged centrally with the city arms; the banner is parted black and red with the arms laid on.

features.role: Blankenburg arms — white tower with antler on black
